steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the engine off, turn the key to RUN.
Within five seconds, push the accelerator pedal slowly to the floor and let it up, three times. The change engine oil light flashes while it resets.
When the light stops flashing, turn the key to LOCK, then start the engine. If the change oil light comes back and stays on, repeat the steps.
variants.note: Reset it at every oil change. If it is reset by mistake, have the oil changed within 3,000 miles of the last service.

variants.when: Suzuki-built models with a low tire pressure light: SX4 (2009), Grand Vitara (2007, 2011), Kizashi (2010)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire information placard on the driver's door jamb.
Turn the ignition on and drive normally. Once the pressures are right the light goes out by itself; there is no reset button.
If the light comes back soon after filling, check for a leaking or flat tire.
At high altitude the light may stay on at the placard pressure; a little extra air clears it.
variants.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix; have a dealer check it.

variants.when: 2009 XL7 (GM-based, pressures shown on the information center)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb placard.
Drive normally. The light and check-tire message clear on their own once each tire is at the right pressure.
After a tire rotation or a new sensor, the system must relearn sensor positions; a dealer can do this, or follow the learn mode in the owner's manual.
variants.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: On the Suzuki-built SX4, Grand Vitara and Kizashi there is no driver reset for the tire pressure light: it clears once the tires are filled correctly. The GM-built XL7 has an engine oil life reminder that the driver resets after each oil change.
